_comment: Generated by tools/make_fixtures.py from the Python model. Do not hand-edit. Regenerate and re-commit if sim/ changes.

temperature_response.why: closed form, but the ramp returns exact 0 below t_min where a relative bound has no meaning

net_carbon.why: closed form, but it is a DIFFERENCE that passes through zero at the crossover: near the root |ref| is ~1e-17 and a pure relative bound would demand bit-exact cancellation between two O(1) terms. 1e-12 umol CO2 m-2 s-1 is ~1e-13 of the values at either end of the grid.

crossover_au.why: bracketed root; the JS port bisects where Python uses scipy brentq with xtol=1e-6, so agreement is bounded by the solver tolerance, not by float precision

edge_cases.name: no_crossover_in_window
edge_cases.why: algal at k=5 (below the registered grid): the root lies beyond r_max, so there is no sign change in [0.5, 100] AU
edge_cases.python_error: no sign change of net carbon on [0.5, 100.0] AU: min=0.1603, max=9.695

edge_cases.name: compensation_at_respiration_boundary
edge_cases.why: r_d == a_max == 10.0 with t_set == t_ref, so leaf respiration equals a_max exactly: no compensation point
edge_cases.python_error: leaf respiration 10.0 >= a_max 10.0: no compensation point

edge_cases.name: algal_t_min_floor
edge_cases.why: T_eq crosses the algal t_min floor (254.65 K) at r=1.194466 AU; temperature_response is 0 at and below it
